diff --git a/integrations/cline/plugin.ts b/integrations/cline/plugin.ts
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/integrations/cline/plugin.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,82 @@
+import { definePlugin, type PluginHooks } from "@cline/sdk";
+import { spawn } from "node:child_process";
+
+interface ClinePayload {
+  workspaceRoots?: string[];
+  cwd?: string;
+  permissionMode?: string;
+  tool?: string;
+  toolCallId?: string;
+  toolInput?: Record<string, unknown>;
+  [key: string]: unknown;
+}
+
+function callHook(event: string, payload: ClinePayload): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
+  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+    const child = spawn("npx", ["--no-install", "matrixcore-hook", "cline", event], {
+      cwd: payload.cwd,
+      stdio: ["pipe", "pipe", "inherit"],
+    });
+    let stdout = "";
+    const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
+      child.kill();
+      reject(new Error(`MatrixCore hook timed out during ${event}`));
+    }, 9000);
+    child.stdout.on("data", chunk => { stdout += chunk.toString(); });
+    child.stdin.end(JSON.stringify(payload));
+    child.on("close", code => {
+      clearTimeout(timeout);
+      if (code !== 0) {
+        reject(new Error(`MatrixCore hook exited with code ${code}`));
+        return;
+      }
+      try {
+        resolve(JSON.parse(stdout.trim()) as Record<string, unknown>);
+      } catch (error) {
+        reject(new Error(`MatrixCore hook returned invalid JSON: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`));
+      }
+    });
+    child.on("error", error => {
+      clearTimeout(timeout);
+      reject(error);
+    });
+  });
+}
+
+async function markDirty(payload: ClinePayload): Promise<void> {
+  await callHook("markDirty", payload);
+}
+
+const hooks: PluginHooks = {
+  turn_start: async context => {
+    await markDirty({ workspaceRoots: context.workspaceRoots, cwd: context.cwd, permissionMode: context.permissionMode });
+  },
+  tool_call_before: async _context => {},
+  tool_call_after: async context => {
+    await markDirty({
+      workspaceRoots: context.workspaceRoots,
+      cwd: context.cwd,
+      permissionMode: context.permissionMode,
+      tool: context.toolCall?.tool,
+      toolCallId: context.toolCall?.id,
+      toolInput: context.toolCall?.input as Record<string, unknown>,
+    });
+  },
+  turn_end: async context => {
+    const result = await callHook("turn_end", {
+      workspaceRoots: context.workspaceRoots,
+      cwd: context.cwd,
+      permissionMode: context.permissionMode,
+    });
+    if (result.cancel) throw new Error(String(result.errorMessage || result.contextModification || "MatrixCore blocked completion"));
+  },
+  iteration_end: async context => {
+    await markDirty({ workspaceRoots: context.workspaceRoots, cwd: context.cwd, permissionMode: context.permissionMode });
+  },
+  run_end: async context => {
+    await markDirty({ workspaceRoots: context.workspaceRoots, cwd: context.cwd, permissionMode: context.permissionMode });
+  },
+};
+
+export default definePlugin({ name: "matrixcore", version: "0.5.0", hooks });
+

+import type { ReviewResult } from "../core/types.js";
+import type { EngineExecution, ReviewWorkItem } from "./engine-types.js";
+import type { ReviewScope } from "./scope.js";
+import type { AgentSmithTrace } from "./trace.js";
+
+function ratio(numerator: number, denominator: number): number | null {
+  return denominator > 0 ? numerator / denominator : null;
+}
+
+function changedLineRanges(diff: string): Map<string, Array<{ start: number; end: number }>> {
+  const ranges = new Map<string, Array<{ start: number; end: number }>>();
+  let file = "";
+  for (const line of diff.split("\n")) {
+    if (line.startsWith("+++ b/")) {
+      file = line.slice(6);
+      continue;
+    }
+    if (!file || !line.startsWith("@@")) continue;
+    const match = /\+(\d+)(?:,(\d+))?/.exec(line);
+    if (!match) continue;
+    const start = Number(match[1]);
+    const count = match[2] === undefined ? 1 : Number(match[2]);
+    if (count <= 0) continue;
+    const values = ranges.get(file) ?? [];
+    values.push({ start, end: start + count - 1 });
+    ranges.set(file, values);
+  }
+  return ranges;
+}
+
+function reviewedChangedLines(scope: ReviewScope, workItems: ReviewWorkItem[]) {
+  const ranges = changedLineRanges(scope.diff);
+  const eligible = new Set<string>();
+  const reviewed = new Set<string>();
+  for (const [file, fileRanges] of ranges)
+    for (const range of fileRanges)
+      for (let line = range.start; line <= range.end; line += 1) eligible.add(`${file}:${line}`);
+  for (const item of workItems)
+    for (const snippet of item.code) {
+      const fileRanges = ranges.get(snippet.file) ?? [];
+      for (const range of fileRanges) {
+        const start = Math.max(range.start, snippet.startLine);
+        const end = Math.min(range.end, snippet.endLine);
+        for (let line = start; line <= end; line += 1) reviewed.add(`${snippet.file}:${line}`);
+      }
+    }
+  return { eligible: eligible.size, reviewed: reviewed.size };
+}
+
+function evidenceMetrics(execution: EngineExecution) {
+  let requests = 0;
+  let validRequests = 0;
+  let resolvedRecords = 0;
+  let relevantRecords = 0;
+  for (const candidate of execution.candidates) {
+    requests += candidate.evidenceRequests.length;
+    validRequests += candidate.evidenceRequests.filter((request) =>
+      Boolean(request.symbol || request.pathHint || request.query),
+    ).length;
+    const records = (execution.evidence[candidate.id] ?? []).slice(1);
+    resolvedRecords += records.length;
+    for (const record of records) {
+      const relevant = candidate.evidenceRequests.some((request) => {
+        const pathMatches = request.pathHint
+          ? record.file === request.pathHint || record.file.includes(request.pathHint)
+          : false;
+        const symbolMatches = request.symbol
+          ? record.symbol === request.symbol || record.symbol?.endsWith(`:${request.symbol}`)
+          : false;
+        const queryMatches = request.query ? record.snippet.includes(request.query) : false;
+        return pathMatches || symbolMatches || queryMatches;
+      });
+      if (relevant) relevantRecords += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  return {
+    requests,
+    validRequests,
+    requestValidityRate: ratio(validRequests, requests),
+    resolvedRecords,
+    relevantRecords,
+    relevanceRate: ratio(relevantRecords, resolvedRecords),
+    unsupportedResolvedRecords: resolvedRecords - relevantRecords,
+  };
+}
+
+export function collectEvalMetrics(opts: {
+  scope: ReviewScope;
+  result: ReviewResult;
+  execution: EngineExecution;
+  durationMs: number;
+}) {
+  const { scope, result, execution } = opts;
+  const coverage = result.coverage;
+  const changedLines = reviewedChangedLines(scope, execution.workItems);
+  const workOmissions = coverage.omissions.filter((item) => item.kind === "work-item");
+  const candidateOmissions = coverage.omissions.filter((item) => item.kind === "candidate");
+  const uniqueWorkIds = new Set([
+    ...execution.workItems.map((item) => item.id),
+    ...workOmissions.map((item) => item.id),
+  ]);
+  const duplicateWorkItemRows = execution.workItems.length + workOmissions.length - uniqueWorkIds.size;
+  const adjudicatedIds = new Set(execution.verification.map((item) => item.candidateId));
+  const modelAdjudicated = execution.verification.filter((item) => item.cacheStatus !== undefined).length;
+  const omittedIds = new Set(candidateOmissions.map((item) => item.id));
+  const omittedHighSeverity = execution.candidates.filter(
+    (candidate) => omittedIds.has(candidate.id) && ["critical", "high"].includes(candidate.severity),
+  ).length;
+  const evidence = evidenceMetrics(execution);
+  const eligibleWorkItems = coverage.localUnitsGenerated + coverage.interactionUnitsGenerated;
+  const reviewedWorkItems = coverage.localUnitsReviewed + coverage.interactionUnitsReviewed;
+  const honesty = {
+    clearWithUnreviewedFiles: result.outcome === "clear" && coverage.changedFilesReviewed < coverage.changedFiles,
+    completedWithCandidateOmissions: result.status === "completed" && candidateOmissions.length > 0,
+    zeroGapsWithUnsupportedEvidence: coverage.evidenceGaps === 0 && evidence.unsupportedResolvedRecords > 0,
+    duplicateWorkItemRows,
+    honest:
+      !(result.outcome === "clear" && coverage.changedFilesReviewed < coverage.changedFiles) &&
+      !(result.status === "completed" && candidateOmissions.length > 0) &&
+      !(coverage.evidenceGaps === 0 && evidence.unsupportedResolvedRecords > 0) &&
+      duplicateWorkItemRows === 0,
+  };
+  return {
+    coverage: {
+      changedFiles: {
+        reviewed: coverage.changedFilesReviewed,
+        eligible: coverage.changedFiles,
+        rate: ratio(coverage.changedFilesReviewed, coverage.changedFiles),
+      },
+      changedSymbols: {
+        reviewed: coverage.changedSymbolsReviewed,
+        eligible: coverage.changedSymbols,
+        rate: ratio(coverage.changedSymbolsReviewed, coverage.changedSymbols),
+      },
+      changedLines: { ...changedLines, rate: ratio(changedLines.reviewed, changedLines.eligible) },
+      localUnits: {
+        reviewed: coverage.localUnitsReviewed,
+        eligible: coverage.localUnitsGenerated,
+        rate: ratio(coverage.localUnitsReviewed, coverage.localUnitsGenerated),
+      },
+      interactionUnits: {
+        reviewed: coverage.interactionUnitsReviewed,
+        eligible: coverage.interactionUnitsGenerated,
+        rate: ratio(coverage.interactionUnitsReviewed, coverage.interactionUnitsGenerated),
+      },
+      workItems: {
+        reviewed: reviewedWorkItems,
+        eligible: eligibleWorkItems,
+        unique: uniqueWorkIds.size,
+        duplicateRows: duplicateWorkItemRows,
+        rate: ratio(reviewedWorkItems, eligibleWorkItems),
+      },
+      globalScan: coverage.globalScan,
+    },
+    candidates: {
+      generated: execution.candidates.length,
+      adjudicated: adjudicatedIds.size,
+      modelAdjudicated,
+      omitted: candidateOmissions.length,
+      omittedHighSeverity,
+      adjudicationRate: ratio(adjudicatedIds.size, execution.candidates.length),
+      modelAdjudicationRate: ratio(modelAdjudicated, execution.candidates.length),
+    },
+    evidence,
+    reliability: {
+      callsStarted: coverage.callsStarted ?? 0,
+      callsCompleted: coverage.callsCompleted ?? 0,
+      callsCancelled: coverage.callsCancelled ?? 0,
+      providerFailures: execution.providerFailures?.length ?? 0,
+      errors: result.errors?.length ?? 0,
+      timeout: Boolean(coverage.timeout),
+    },
+    efficiency: {
+      durationMs: opts.durationMs,
+      inputTokens: execution.inputTokens,
+      outputTokens: execution.outputTokens,
+      calls: coverage.callsStarted ?? 0,
+      reviewedChangedLinesPerSecond: opts.durationMs > 0 ? changedLines.reviewed / (opts.durationMs / 1000) : null,
+      reviewedChangedLinesPerThousandInputTokens:
+        execution.inputTokens > 0 ? changedLines.reviewed / (execution.inputTokens / 1000) : null,
+    },
+    honesty,
+  };
+}
+
+export function collectTraceMetrics(trace: AgentSmithTrace) {
+  if (!trace.execution) throw new Error(`Trace ${trace.traceId} does not contain AgentSmith execution data`);
+  return collectEvalMetrics({
+    scope: trace.scope,
+    result: trace.result,
+    execution: trace.execution,
+    durationMs: trace.result.coverage.elapsedMs ?? trace.result.coverage.timeout?.elapsedMs ?? 0,
+  });
+}
+

@@ -0,0 +1,117 @@
+import type { AgentSmithConfig, ModelProfile } from "../core/types.js";
+import type { AgentSmithTrace } from "./trace.js";
+import type { ProviderResponse, ReviewOutputKind, ReviewProvider } from "./provider.js";
+
+interface Cassette {
+  outputKind: ReviewOutputKind;
+  model: string;
+  prompt: string;
+  response: ProviderResponse;
+  used: boolean;
+}
+
+function traceCassettes(trace: AgentSmithTrace): Cassette[] {
+  const execution = trace.execution;
+  if (!execution) return [];
+  const rawProfiles = execution.modelProfiles as unknown;
+  const profiles = Array.isArray(rawProfiles)
+    ? { candidate: rawProfiles[0] as ModelProfile, verifier: (rawProfiles[1] ?? rawProfiles[0]) as ModelProfile }
+    : execution.modelProfiles;
+  const values: Cassette[] = [];
+  for (const batch of execution.candidateBatches)
+    if (batch.prompt !== undefined && batch.raw !== undefined)
+      values.push({
+        outputKind: "candidates",
+        model: profiles.candidate.model,
+        prompt: batch.prompt,
+        response: {
+          raw: batch.raw,
+          usage: { inputTokens: batch.inputTokens, outputTokens: batch.outputTokens },
+          completion: batch.completion,
+        },
+        used: false,
+      });
+  if (execution.scout)
+    values.push({
+      outputKind: "scout",
+      model: profiles.scout?.model ?? profiles.candidate.model,
+      prompt: execution.scout.prompt,
+      response: {
+        raw: execution.scout.raw,
+        usage: { inputTokens: execution.scout.inputTokens, outputTokens: execution.scout.outputTokens },
+        completion: execution.scout.completion,
+      },
+      used: false,
+    });
+  for (const verification of execution.verification)
+    if (verification.prompt !== undefined && verification.raw !== undefined)
+      values.push({
+        outputKind: "verification",
+        model: profiles.verifier.model,
+        prompt: verification.prompt,
+        response: {
+          raw: verification.raw,
+          usage: { inputTokens: 0, outputTokens: 0 },
+          completion: verification.completion,
+        },
+        used: false,
+      });
+  return values;
+}
+
+export class RecordedReviewProvider implements ReviewProvider {
+  private readonly cassettes: Cassette[];
+  private readonly models: string[];
+
+  constructor(trace: AgentSmithTrace) {
+    this.cassettes = traceCassettes(trace);
+    const rawProfiles = trace.execution?.modelProfiles as unknown;
+    const profiles = Array.isArray(rawProfiles) ? rawProfiles : Object.values(trace.execution?.modelProfiles ?? {});
+    this.models = [
+      ...new Set(
+        profiles.filter((profile): profile is ModelProfile => Boolean(profile)).map((profile) => profile.model),
+      ),
+    ];
+  }
+
+  async health() {
+    return { ok: true, models: this.models };
+  }
+
+  async invoke(input: Parameters<ReviewProvider["invoke"]>[0]): Promise<ProviderResponse> {
+    const cassette = this.cassettes.find(
+      (candidate) =>
+        !candidate.used &&
+        candidate.outputKind === input.outputKind &&
+        candidate.model === input.profile.model &&
+        candidate.prompt === input.prompt,
+    );
+    if (!cassette)
+      throw new Error(
+        `Recorded replay miss for ${input.outputKind} using ${input.profile.model}; prompt or strategy changed`,
+      );
+    cassette.used = true;
+    return structuredClone(cassette.response);
+  }
+}
+
+export class PlannerReviewProvider implements ReviewProvider {
+  constructor(private readonly config: AgentSmithConfig) {}
+
+  async health() {
+    return { ok: true, models: [...new Set(this.config.model_profiles.map((profile) => profile.model))] };
+  }
+
+  async invoke(input: Parameters<ReviewProvider["invoke"]>[0]): Promise<ProviderResponse> {
+    return {
+      raw:
+        input.outputKind === "scout"
+          ? '{"hotspots":[]}'
+          : input.outputKind === "verification"
+            ? '{"verdict":"rejected","confidence":1,"supportingEvidenceIds":[]}'
+            : '{"c":[]}',
+      usage: { inputTokens: 0, outputTokens: 0 },
+    };
+  }
+}
+

@@ -0,0 +1,228 @@
+import crypto from "node:crypto";
+import fs from "node:fs";
+import os from "node:os";
+import path from "node:path";
+import { COMPLETION_LOCK_FILE, COMPLETION_RESULT_FILE, qualityStorePath } from "./meta.js";
+import { computeWorkspaceVersion } from "./version.js";
+import { resolveConfig } from "./config-resolver.js";
+import { resolvePolicyForConfig } from "./resolved-policy.js";
+import type { QualityCompletionResult } from "./types.js";
+
+interface CompletionIdentity {
+  repositoryHash: string;
+  policyHash: string;
+}
+
+interface CompletionLock {
+  schemaVersion: 1;
+  runId: string;
+  pid: number;
+  hostname: string;
+  startedAt: string;
+  updatedAt: string;
+  leaseUntil: string;
+  identity: CompletionIdentity;
+}
+
+interface StoredCompletionResult {
+  schemaVersion: 1;
+  runId: string;
+  identity: CompletionIdentity;
+  status: "COMPLETED" | "ERROR";
+  completedAt: string;
+  result?: QualityCompletionResult;
+  error?: string;
+}
+
+const localRuns = new Map<string, Promise<QualityCompletionResult>>();
+
+function identity(root: string): CompletionIdentity {
+  const resolved = resolveConfig({ cwd: root });
+  return {
+    repositoryHash: computeWorkspaceVersion(root),
+    policyHash: resolvePolicyForConfig(resolved).policyHash,
+  };
+}
+
+function sameIdentity(left: CompletionIdentity, right: CompletionIdentity): boolean {
+  return left.repositoryHash === right.repositoryHash && left.policyHash === right.policyHash;
+}
+
+function readJson<T>(file: string): T | null {
+  try {
+    return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8")) as T;
+  } catch {
+    return null;
+  }
+}
+
+function atomicWrite(file: string, value: unknown): void {
+  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true });
+  const temporary = `${file}.${process.pid}.${crypto.randomUUID()}.tmp`;
+  fs.writeFileSync(temporary, `${JSON.stringify(value, null, 2)}\n`);
+  fs.renameSync(temporary, file);
+}
+
+function processAlive(pid: number): boolean {
+  try {
+    process.kill(pid, 0);
+    return true;
+  } catch (error) {
+    return (error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === "EPERM";
+  }
+}
+
+function appendEvent(root: string, event: Record<string, unknown>): void {
+  try {
+    const file = qualityStorePath(root, "completion-events.jsonl");
+    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true });
+    fs.appendFileSync(file, `${JSON.stringify({ timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), ...event })}\n`);
+  } catch {}
+}
+
+function wait(delayMs: number, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<void> {
+  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+    if (signal?.aborted) return reject(signal.reason ?? new Error("Completion cancelled"));
+    const onAbort = () => {
+      clearTimeout(timer);
+      reject(signal?.reason ?? new Error("Completion cancelled"));
+    };
+    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
+      signal?.removeEventListener("abort", onAbort);
+      resolve();
+    }, delayMs);
+    signal?.addEventListener("abort", onAbort, { once: true });
+  });
+}
+
+async function coordinatedRun(
+  root: string,
+  signal: AbortSignal | undefined,
+  execute: () => Promise<QualityCompletionResult>,
+): Promise<QualityCompletionResult> {
+  const requestedIdentity = identity(root);
+  const lockPath = qualityStorePath(root, COMPLETION_LOCK_FILE);
+  const resultPath = qualityStorePath(root, COMPLETION_RESULT_FILE);
+  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(lockPath), { recursive: true });
+
+  while (true) {
+    if (signal?.aborted) throw signal.reason ?? new Error("Completion cancelled");
+    let descriptor: number;
+    try {
+      descriptor = fs.openSync(lockPath, "wx");
+    } catch (error) {
+      if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code !== "EEXIST") throw error;
+      const active = readJson<CompletionLock>(lockPath);
+      const expired = active ? Date.parse(active.leaseUntil) <= Date.now() : false;
+      const dead = active ? active.hostname === os.hostname() && !processAlive(active.pid) : false;
+      let malformedAndStale = false;
+      if (!active) {
+        try {
+          malformedAndStale = Date.now() - fs.statSync(lockPath).mtimeMs > 60_000;
+        } catch {}
+      }
+      if ((active && (expired || dead)) || malformedAndStale) {
+        const latest = readJson<CompletionLock>(lockPath);
+        if ((active && latest?.runId === active.runId) || (!active && latest === null)) {
+          fs.unlinkSync(lockPath);
+          appendEvent(root, {
+            type: "stale_lock_recovered",
+            runId: active?.runId ?? null,
+            pid: active?.pid ?? null,
+          });
+          continue;
+        }
+      }
+      const joinedRunId = active?.runId;
+      appendEvent(root, { type: "run_joined", runId: joinedRunId ?? null, pid: process.pid });
+      while (fs.existsSync(lockPath)) await wait(100, signal);
+      const completed = readJson<StoredCompletionResult>(resultPath);
+      if (completed && completed.runId === joinedRunId && sameIdentity(completed.identity, requestedIdentity)) {
+        if (completed.status === "COMPLETED" && completed.result) return completed.result;
+        throw new Error(completed.error ?? "Joined completion run failed");
+      }
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const runId = crypto.randomUUID();
+    const acquiredIdentity = identity(root);
+    const resolved = resolveConfig({ cwd: root });
+    const duration = Math.max(60_000, resolved.config.agentsmith?.maxDurationMs ?? 600_000) + 60_000;
+    const startedAt = new Date().toISOString();
+    let lock: CompletionLock = {
+      schemaVersion: 1,
+      runId,
+      pid: process.pid,
+      hostname: os.hostname(),
+      startedAt,
+      updatedAt: startedAt,
+      leaseUntil: new Date(Date.now() + duration).toISOString(),
+      identity: acquiredIdentity,
+    };
+    const writeLock = () => {
+      lock = {
+        ...lock,
+        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
+        leaseUntil: new Date(Date.now() + duration).toISOString(),
+      };
+      fs.ftruncateSync(descriptor, 0);
+      fs.writeSync(descriptor, `${JSON.stringify(lock, null, 2)}\n`, 0, "utf8");
+      fs.fsyncSync(descriptor);
+    };
+    writeLock();
+    const heartbeat = setInterval(writeLock, 5000);
+    heartbeat.unref();
+    appendEvent(root, { type: "run_started", runId, pid: process.pid, ...acquiredIdentity });
+    try {
+      const result = await execute();
+      const stored: StoredCompletionResult = {
+        schemaVersion: 1,
+        runId,
+        identity: acquiredIdentity,
+        status: "COMPLETED",
+        completedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
+        result,
+      };
+      atomicWrite(resultPath, stored);
+      appendEvent(root, {
+        type: "run_completed",
+        runId,
+        result: result.completionAllowed ? "PASS" : result.gate.status === "FAIL" ? "REJECT" : "ERROR",
+      });
+      return result;
+    } catch (error) {
+      const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
+      atomicWrite(resultPath, {
+        schemaVersion: 1,
+        runId,
+        identity: acquiredIdentity,
+        status: "ERROR",
+        completedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
+        error: message,
+      } satisfies StoredCompletionResult);
+      appendEvent(root, { type: "run_error", runId, error: message });
+      throw error;
+    } finally {
+      clearInterval(heartbeat);
+      fs.closeSync(descriptor);
+      const current = readJson<CompletionLock>(lockPath);
+      if (current?.runId === runId) fs.unlinkSync(lockPath);
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export function coordinateQualityCompletion(
+  root: string,
+  signal: AbortSignal | undefined,
+  execute: () => Promise<QualityCompletionResult>,
+): Promise<QualityCompletionResult> {
+  const canonicalRoot = fs.realpathSync(root);
+  const existing = localRuns.get(canonicalRoot);
+  if (existing) return existing;
+  const running = coordinatedRun(canonicalRoot, signal, execute).finally(() => {
+    if (localRuns.get(canonicalRoot) === running) localRuns.delete(canonicalRoot);
+  });
+  localRuns.set(canonicalRoot, running);
+  return running;
+}
+

@@ -0,0 +1,67 @@
+import path from "node:path";
+import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
+
+export interface ToolProbeResult {
+  binary: string;
+  found: boolean;
+  version: string | null;
+  exitCode: number | null;
+  signal: NodeJS.Signals | null;
+  timedOut: boolean;
+  errorCode?: string;
+  errorMessage?: string;
+  stdout: string;
+  stderr: string;
+}
+
+function pathKey(env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv): string {
+  if (process.platform !== "win32") return "PATH";
+  return Object.keys(env).find((key) => key.toLowerCase() === "path") ?? "Path";
+}
+
+export function childProcessEnv(base: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env): NodeJS.ProcessEnv {
+  const env = { ...base };
+  const key = pathKey(env);
+  const runtimeDirectory = path.dirname(process.execPath);
+  const entries = (env[key] ?? "").split(path.delimiter).filter(Boolean);
+  env[key] = [
+    runtimeDirectory,
+    ...entries.filter((entry) => path.resolve(entry) !== path.resolve(runtimeDirectory)),
+  ].join(path.delimiter);
+  return env;
+}
+
+export function probeToolVersion(binary: string, timeout = 5000): ToolProbeResult {
+  const result = spawnSync(binary, ["--version"], {
+    encoding: "utf8",
+    timeout,
+    env: childProcessEnv(),
+  });
+  const stdout = result.stdout || "";
+  const stderr = result.stderr || "";
+  const error = result.error as NodeJS.ErrnoException | undefined;
+  const combined = `${stdout}${stderr}`;
+  const version = result.status === 0 ? (combined.match(/\d+(?:\.\d+){1,2}/)?.[0] ?? null) : null;
+  return {
+    binary,
+    found: !error && result.status === 0 && version !== null,
+    version,
+    exitCode: result.status,
+    signal: result.signal,
+    timedOut: error?.code === "ETIMEDOUT",
+    errorCode: error?.code,
+    errorMessage: error?.message,
+    stdout,
+    stderr,
+  };
+}
+
+export function describeToolProbe(tool: string, probe: ToolProbeResult): string {
+  if (probe.timedOut) return `${tool} version probe timed out for ${probe.binary}`;
+  if (probe.errorMessage)
+    return `${tool} could not execute ${probe.binary}: ${probe.errorCode ? `${probe.errorCode}: ` : ""}${probe.errorMessage}`;
+  if (probe.exitCode !== 0)
+    return `${tool} version probe exited ${probe.exitCode ?? "without a status"} for ${probe.binary}${probe.stderr.trim() ? `: ${probe.stderr.trim()}` : ""}`;
+  return `${tool} returned an unrecognized version from ${probe.binary}`;
+}
+

+import { computeWorkspaceVersion } from "./version.js";
+import { turnStore } from "./turn-store.js";
+import { runGate, type RunGateOptions } from "./gate.js";
+import { getQualityStatus } from "./status.js";
+import { resolveConfig } from "./config-resolver.js";
+import { resolvePolicyForConfig } from "./resolved-policy.js";
+import type { TurnGateResult, ValidationEvidence, TurnGateState } from "./turn-types.js";
+import type { GateResult } from "./types.js";
+
+const MAX_RETRIES = 3;
+
+function toValidationEvidence(gate: GateResult, policyHash: string): ValidationEvidence {
+  const checks = gate.checks.map((c) => ({
+    name: c.plugin,
+    status: c.status as "PASS" | "FAIL" | "ERROR" | "SKIPPED",
+    findings: c.observations?.map((o) => o.message) ?? [],
+  }));
+  return {
+    schemaVersion: 1,
+    repositoryHash: gate.version,
+    policyHash,
+    result: gate.status === "PASS" ? "PASS" : gate.status === "FAIL" ? "REJECT" : "ERROR",
+    checks,
+    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
+    gateVersion: gate.version,
+    gateMode: gate.mode,
+    gateFast: gate.fast,
+  };
+}
+
+function getPolicyHash(root: string): string {
+  const resolved = resolveConfig({ cwd: root });
+  const policy = resolvePolicyForConfig(resolved);
+  return policy.policyHash;
+}
+
+export class TurnGate {
+  private root: string;
+
+  constructor(root: string) {
+    this.root = root;
+  }
+
+  async onCandidateComplete(host: "cline" | "codex" | "claude", turnId?: string): Promise<TurnGateResult> {
+    const currentHash = computeWorkspaceVersion(this.root);
+    const policyHash = getPolicyHash(this.root);
+    const maxRetries = resolveConfig({ cwd: this.root }).config.gates?.max_retries ?? MAX_RETRIES;
+    const initialStatus = getQualityStatus(this.root);
+    if (!initialStatus.configured) {
+      return {
+        decision: "allow",
+        reason: "MatrixCore is not configured for this workspace",
+        currentHash,
+        validatedHash: null,
+        retryCount: 0,
+      };
+    }
+
+    // First, check if there's a matching PASS gate
+    let gate = turnStore.getState(this.root).lastValidationEvidence ? await this.readGateForHash(currentHash) : null;
+
+    if (!gate) {
+      const { readGateResult } = await import("./gate-store.js");
+      const fullGate = readGateResult(this.root, "full");
+      if (fullGate && fullGate.version === currentHash && fullGate.status === "PASS") {
+        gate = fullGate;
+      }
+    }
+
+    if (gate && gate.version === currentHash && gate.status === "PASS") {
+      // Use getQualityStatus which already composes version + live workspaceHash + policyHash + toolVersions
+      const status = getQualityStatus(this.root);
+
+      if (!status.completionAllowed) {
+        const state = turnStore.candidateComplete(this.root, host, currentHash, turnId);
+        const retryCount = state.retryCountByHash[currentHash] || 0;
+        if (retryCount > maxRetries) {
+          turnStore.validationFailed(this.root, currentHash, host, turnId);
+          return {
+            decision: "error",
+            reason: `Validation failed after ${maxRetries} attempts. Repository hash: ${currentHash.slice(0, 12)}. Manual intervention required.`,
+            currentHash,
+            validatedHash: state.validatedHash,
+            retryCount,
+          };
+        }
+        return {
+          decision: "block",
+          reason: `${status.reason ?? "Completion evidence is not current. Re-run validation."} (policy=${policyHash})`,
+          currentHash,
+          validatedHash: state.validatedHash,
+          retryCount,
+        };
+      }
+
+      const finalHash = computeWorkspaceVersion(this.root);
+      const finalStatus = getQualityStatus(this.root);
+      if (finalHash !== currentHash || !finalStatus.completionAllowed) {
+        const state = turnStore.candidateComplete(this.root, host, finalHash, turnId);
+        return {
+          decision: "block",
+          reason:
+            finalHash !== currentHash
+              ? "Repository changed while completion was being checked. Run final validation again."
+              : (finalStatus.reason ?? "Completion evidence is no longer current."),
+          currentHash: finalHash,
+          validatedHash: state.validatedHash,
+          retryCount: state.retryCountByHash[finalHash] || 0,
+        };
+      }
+
+      // Matching PASS gate found - persist and allow only after the store verifies the live hash
+      const state = turnStore.getState(this.root);
+      if (state.retryCountByHash[currentHash]) {
+        delete state.retryCountByHash[currentHash];
+      }
+      const evidence = toValidationEvidence(gate, policyHash);
+      const completed = turnStore.validationComplete(this.root, evidence, host, turnId);
+      if (completed.status !== "VALIDATED_COMPLETE") {
+        return {
+          decision: "block",
+          reason: "Repository changed while completion evidence was being persisted. Run final validation again.",
+          currentHash,
+          validatedHash: completed.validatedHash,
+          retryCount: completed.retryCountByHash[currentHash] || 0,
+        };
+      }
+      return {
+        decision: "allow",
+        reason: `Validation PASS for current repository state`,
+        currentHash,
+        validatedHash: currentHash,
+        evidence,
+        retryCount: 0,
+      };
+    }
+
+    // No matching PASS gate - check retry count
+    const status = initialStatus;
+    const state = turnStore.candidateComplete(this.root, host, currentHash, turnId);
+    const retryCount = state.retryCountByHash[currentHash] || 0;
+
+    if (retryCount > maxRetries) {
+      turnStore.validationFailed(this.root, currentHash, host, turnId);
+      return {
+        decision: "error",
+        reason: `Validation failed after ${maxRetries} attempts. Repository hash: ${currentHash.slice(0, 12)}. Manual intervention required.`,
+        currentHash,
+        validatedHash: state.validatedHash,
+        retryCount,
+      };
+    }
+
+    const findings = this.extractFindings(status);
+
+    return {
+      decision: "block",
+      reason: `Final validation required for current repository state (${currentHash.slice(0, 12)}). Run the configured validation pipeline and resolve all failures. ${findings} (policy=${policyHash})`,
+      currentHash,
+      validatedHash: state.validatedHash,
+      retryCount,
+    };
+  }
+
+  private async readGateForHash(hash: string): Promise<GateResult | null> {
+    const { readGateResult } = await import("./gate-store.js");
+    const gate = readGateResult(this.root, "full");
+    if (gate && gate.version === hash) return gate;
+    return null;
+  }
+
+  private extractFindings(status: ReturnType<typeof getQualityStatus>): string {
+    const parts: string[] = [];
+    if (status.gate?.checks) {
+      const failures = status.gate.checks.filter((c) => c.status === "FAIL");
+      if (failures.length) {
+        parts.push(`Failures: ${failures.map((f) => `${f.plugin}: ${f.reason || f.status}`).join(", ")}`);
+      }
+    }
+    if (status.review?.findings?.length) {
+      parts.push(`Review: ${status.review.findings.length} findings`);
+    }
+    return parts.join("; ");
+  }
+
+  async onValidationComplete(mode: "full" | "changed" = "full"): Promise<TurnGateResult> {
+    const currentHash = computeWorkspaceVersion(this.root);
+
+    const opts: RunGateOptions = {
+      cwd: this.root,
+      mode,
+      tool: "quality_run",
+      adapter: "cli",
+    };
+    const gate = await runGate(opts);
+    const policyHash = getPolicyHash(this.root);
+    const evidence = toValidationEvidence(gate, policyHash);
+
+    if (gate.status === "PASS") {
+      const completed = turnStore.validationComplete(this.root, evidence);
+      return {
+        decision: completed.status === "VALIDATED_COMPLETE" ? "allow" : "block",
+        reason:
+          completed.status === "VALIDATED_COMPLETE"
+            ? "Validation completed successfully"
+            : "Validation evidence is stale; rerun the gate",
+        currentHash,
+        validatedHash: gate.version,
+        evidence,
+        retryCount: 0,
+      };
+    }
+
+    // Distinguish infra ERROR from code REJECT
+    // GateResult.status is "PASS" | "FAIL" | "RUNNING" | "EXPIRED" - no "ERROR"
+    // Infra errors manifest as FAIL with specific failure messages
+    const isInfraError =
+      gate.status === "FAIL" &&
+      gate.failures.some(
+        (f) =>
+          f.includes("required workspace tool missing") ||
+          f.includes("executable not found but required=true") ||
+          f.includes("executable not found in designated environment") ||
+          f.includes("deptry and Python must exist in the designated virtual environment") ||
+          f.includes("tsc not found but required=true") ||
+          f.includes("eslint not found") ||
+          f.includes("prettier not found") ||
+          f.includes("SQLFluff and its Python environment are missing from the designated SQL facet") ||
+          f.includes("golangci-lint not found") ||
+          f.includes("go not found") ||
+          f.includes("go missing") ||
+          f.includes("not found but required=true") ||
+          f.includes("Clippy not found") ||
+          f.includes("not found but required=true") ||
+          f.includes("executable not found but required=true"),
+      );
+    const decision = isInfraError ? "error" : "block";
+    evidence.result = isInfraError ? "ERROR" : "REJECT";
+    turnStore.validationComplete(this.root, evidence);
+    return {
+      decision,
+      reason:
+        gate.status === "FAIL"
+          ? `Validation FAIL: ${gate.failures.join(", ")}`
+          : `Validation ${gate.status}: ${gate.failures.join(", ")}`,
+      currentHash,
+      validatedHash: gate.version,
+      evidence,
+      retryCount: 0,
+    };
+  }
+
+  onDirty(host: "cline" | "codex" | "claude" = "cline", turnId?: string): void {
+    const currentHash = computeWorkspaceVersion(this.root);
+    turnStore.setDirty(this.root, currentHash, host, turnId);
+  }
+
+  getStatus(): TurnGateState {
+    return turnStore.getState(this.root);
+  }
+}
+

@@ -0,0 +1,312 @@
+import fs from "node:fs";
+import path from "node:path";
+import crypto from "node:crypto";
+import { computeWorkspaceVersion } from "./version.js";
+import { resolveConfig } from "./config-resolver.js";
+import { resolvePolicyForConfig } from "./resolved-policy.js";
+import type { GateResult } from "./types.js";
+import type { TurnGateState, ValidationEvidence, TurnEvent } from "./turn-types.js";
+
+const STORE_DIR = ".quality";
+const STATE_FILE = "turn-state.json";
+const EVENTS_FILE = "turn-events.jsonl";
+
+function storePath(root: string): string {
+  return path.join(root, STORE_DIR, STATE_FILE);
+}
+
+function eventsPath(root: string): string {
+  return path.join(root, STORE_DIR, EVENTS_FILE);
+}
+
+function currentPolicyHash(root: string): string | null {
+  try {
+    return resolvePolicyForConfig(resolveConfig({ cwd: root })).policyHash;
+  } catch {
+    return null;
+  }
+}
+
+function withStoreLock<T>(root: string, action: () => T): T {
+  const lockPath = path.join(root, STORE_DIR, "turn-state.lock");
+  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(lockPath), { recursive: true });
+  let fd: number | undefined;
+  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 200; attempt += 1) {
+    try {
+      fd = fs.openSync(lockPath, "wx");
+      break;
+    } catch (error) {
+      if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code !== "EEXIST") throw error;
+      const wait = new Int32Array(new SharedArrayBuffer(4));
+      Atomics.wait(wait, 0, 0, 10);
+    }
+  }
+  if (fd === undefined) throw new Error("Timed out acquiring MatrixCore turn-state lock");
+  try {
+    return action();
+  } finally {
+    fs.closeSync(fd);
+    try {
+      fs.unlinkSync(lockPath);
+    } catch {}
+  }
+}
+
+function defaultState(): TurnGateState {
+  return {
+    schemaVersion: 1,
+    dirty: false,
+    currentHash: null,
+    validatedHash: null,
+    status: "RUNNING",
+    attempts: 0,
+    lastValidationEvidence: null,
+    retryCountByHash: {},
+    activeTurnId: null,
+    updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
+  };
+}
+
+function readState(root: string): TurnGateState {
+  const p = storePath(root);
+  try {
+    const raw = fs.readFileSync(p, "utf8");
+    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as TurnGateState;
+    if (parsed.schemaVersion === 1) return parsed;
+  } catch {}
+  return defaultState();
+}
+
+function writeState(root: string, state: TurnGateState): void {
+  const dir = path.dirname(storePath(root));
+  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
+  const tmp = `${storePath(root)}.${process.pid}.${crypto.randomUUID()}.tmp`;
+  state.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
+  fs.writeFileSync(tmp, JSON.stringify(state, null, 2));
+  fs.renameSync(tmp, storePath(root));
+}
+
+function appendEvent(root: string, event: TurnEvent): void {
+  const p = eventsPath(root);
+  try {
+    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(p), { recursive: true });
+    fs.appendFileSync(p, `${JSON.stringify(event)}\n`);
+  } catch {}
+}
+
+export const turnStore = {
+  getState(root: string): TurnGateState {
+    return readState(root);
+  },
+
+  setDirty(
+    root: string,
+    currentHash: string,
+    host: "cline" | "codex" | "claude" | "cli" | "mcp" = "cline",
+    turnId?: string,
+  ): void {
+    withStoreLock(root, () => {
+      const state = readState(root);
+      state.dirty = true;
+      state.currentHash = currentHash;
+      state.status = "RUNNING";
+      if (turnId) state.activeTurnId = turnId;
+      writeState(root, state);
+      appendEvent(root, {
+        type: "DIRTY",
+        host,
+        turnId,
+        payload: { hash: currentHash },
+        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
+      });
+    });
+  },
+
+  candidateComplete(
+    root: string,
+    host: "cline" | "codex" | "claude",
+    currentHash: string,
+    turnId?: string,
+  ): TurnGateState {
+    return withStoreLock(root, () => {
+      const state = readState(root);
+      if (turnId && state.activeTurnId !== turnId) {
+        state.retryCountByHash = {};
+        state.activeTurnId = turnId;
+      }
+      state.currentHash = currentHash;
+      state.attempts += 1;
+      state.status = "VALIDATING";
+      const count = state.retryCountByHash[currentHash] || 0;
+      state.retryCountByHash[currentHash] = count + 1;
+      writeState(root, state);
+      appendEvent(root, {
+        type: "CANDIDATE_COMPLETE",
+        host,
+        turnId,
+        payload: { hash: currentHash },
+        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
+      });
+      return state;
+    });
+  },
+
+  validationComplete(
+    root: string,
+    evidence: ValidationEvidence,
+    host: "cline" | "codex" | "claude" | "cli" | "mcp" = "cline",
+    turnId?: string,
+  ): TurnGateState {
+    return withStoreLock(root, () => {
+      const state = readState(root);
+      const liveHash = computeWorkspaceVersion(root);
+      const policyMatches = currentPolicyHash(root) === evidence.policyHash;
+      state.currentHash = liveHash;
+      const completionEligible = evidence.gateMode === "full" && evidence.gateFast !== true;
+      state.dirty =
+        evidence.result !== "PASS" || !completionEligible || liveHash !== evidence.repositoryHash || !policyMatches;
+      if (evidence.result === "PASS" && completionEligible && liveHash === evidence.repositoryHash && policyMatches) {
+        state.validatedHash = evidence.repositoryHash;
+        state.status = "VALIDATED_COMPLETE";
+      } else {
+        state.status = evidence.result === "REJECT" ? "REJECT" : "ERROR";
+      }
+      state.lastValidationEvidence = evidence;
+      if (turnId) state.activeTurnId = turnId;
+      if (
+        evidence.result === "PASS" &&
+        completionEligible &&
+        liveHash === evidence.repositoryHash &&
+        policyMatches &&
+        state.retryCountByHash[evidence.repositoryHash]
+      ) {
+        delete state.retryCountByHash[evidence.repositoryHash];
+      }
+      writeState(root, state);
+      appendEvent(root, {
+        type:
+          liveHash === evidence.repositoryHash && evidence.result === "PASS" && completionEligible && policyMatches
+            ? "VALIDATED_COMPLETE"
+            : "VALIDATION_COMPLETE",
+        host,
+        turnId,
+        payload: { result: evidence.result, hash: evidence.repositoryHash, liveHash, policyMatches },
+        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
+      });
+      return state;
+    });
+  },
+
+  validationFailed(
+    root: string,
+    currentHash: string,
+    host: "cline" | "codex" | "claude" = "cline",
+    turnId?: string,
+  ): TurnGateState {
+    return withStoreLock(root, () => {
+      const state = readState(root);
+      state.status = "VALIDATION_FAILED";
+      state.dirty = true;
+      state.currentHash = currentHash;
+      writeState(root, state);
+      appendEvent(root, {
+        type: "GATE_FAILED",
+        host,
+        turnId,
+        payload: { result: "ERROR", hash: currentHash },
+        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
+      });
+      return state;
+    });
+  },
+
+  cancelled(root: string): TurnGateState {
+    return withStoreLock(root, () => {
+      const state = readState(root);
+      state.status = "CANCELLED";
+      writeState(root, state);
+      appendEvent(root, {
+        type: "CANCELLED",
+        host: "cline",
+        payload: { result: "CANCELLED" },
+        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
+      });
+      return state;
+    });
+  },
+
+  failed(root: string, error: string, host: "cline" | "codex" | "claude" = "cline", turnId?: string): TurnGateState {
+    return withStoreLock(root, () => {
+      const state = readState(root);
+      state.status = "ERROR";
+      state.dirty = true;
+      state.currentHash = state.currentHash || computeWorkspaceVersion(root);
+      writeState(root, state);
+      appendEvent(root, {
+        type: "GATE_FAILED",
+        host,
+        turnId,
+        payload: { result: "ERROR", error },
+        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
+      });
+      return state;
+    });
+  },
+
+  recordGateResult(
+    root: string,
+    gate: GateResult,
+    result: ValidationEvidence["result"],
+    host: "cline" | "codex" | "claude" | "cli" | "mcp" = "cline",
+    turnId?: string,
+  ): TurnGateState {
+    const evidence: ValidationEvidence = {
+      schemaVersion: 1,
+      repositoryHash: gate.version,
+      policyHash: gate.policy.policyHash,
+      result,
+      checks: gate.checks.map((check) => ({
+        name: check.plugin,
+        status:
+          check.status === "FAIL"
+            ? "FAIL"
+            : check.status === "ERROR"
+              ? "ERROR"
+              : check.status === "SKIPPED"
+                ? "SKIPPED"
+                : "PASS",
+        findings: check.observations?.map((observation) => observation.message) ?? [],
+      })),
+      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
+      gateVersion: gate.version,
+      gateMode: gate.mode,
+      gateFast: gate.fast,
+    };
+    return turnStore.validationComplete(root, evidence, host, turnId);
+  },
+
+  reset(root: string): TurnGateState {
+    return withStoreLock(root, () => {
+      const state = defaultState();
+      writeState(root, state);
+      appendEvent(root, { type: "RESET", host: "cline", payload: {}, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() });
+      return state;
+    });
+  },
+
+  getRetryCount(root: string, hash: string): number {
+    const state = readState(root);
+    return state.retryCountByHash[hash] || 0;
+  },
+
+  listEvents(root: string, limit = 50): TurnEvent[] {
+    const p = eventsPath(root);
+    try {
+      const lines = fs.readFileSync(p, "utf8").trim().split("\n").filter(Boolean);
+      return lines.slice(-limit).map((l) => JSON.parse(l) as TurnEvent);
+    } catch {
+      return [];
+    }
+  },
+};
+

+export type TurnStatus =
+  "RUNNING" | "VALIDATING" | "VALIDATED_COMPLETE" | "REJECT" | "ERROR" | "CANCELLED" | "VALIDATION_FAILED";
+
+export interface RepoHash {
+  hash: string;
+  computedAt: string;
+  head: string;
+  dirtyFiles: string[];
+}
+
+export interface ValidationCheck {
+  name: string;
+  status: "PASS" | "FAIL" | "ERROR" | "SKIPPED";
+  findings: string[];
+}
+
+export interface ValidationEvidence {
+  schemaVersion: number;
+  repositoryHash: string;
+  policyHash: string;
+  result: "PASS" | "REJECT" | "ERROR";
+  checks: ValidationCheck[];
+  timestamp: string;
+  reviewId?: string;
+  gateVersion: string;
+  gateMode: "full" | "changed" | "fast";
+  gateFast?: boolean;
+}
+
+export interface TurnGateState {
+  schemaVersion: number;
+  dirty: boolean;
+  currentHash: string | null;
+  validatedHash: string | null;
+  status: TurnStatus;
+  attempts: number;
+  lastValidationEvidence: ValidationEvidence | null;
+  retryCountByHash: Record<string, number>;
+  activeTurnId: string | null;
+  updatedAt: string;
+}
+
+export interface TurnEvent {
+  type:
+    | "DIRTY"
+    | "CANDIDATE_COMPLETE"
+    | "VALIDATION_COMPLETE"
+    | "VALIDATED_COMPLETE"
+    | "GATE_FAILED"
+    | "CANCELLED"
+    | "RESET";
+  host: "cline" | "codex" | "claude" | "cli" | "mcp";
+  turnId?: string;
+  payload: Record<string, unknown>;
+  timestamp: string;
+}
+
+export interface TurnGateResult {
+  decision: "allow" | "block" | "error";
+  reason: string;
+  currentHash: string;
+  validatedHash: string | null;
+  evidence?: ValidationEvidence;
+  retryCount: number;
+}
+

+import fs from "node:fs";
+import path from "node:path";
+
+const ENGINE_NAME = "matrix-core";
+
+function isVerboseEnabled(): boolean {
+  const value = process.env.MATRIXCORE_LOG ?? "";
+  return value.toLowerCase() === "debug" || value.toLowerCase() === "verbose";
+}
+
+function verboseLogRoot(root: string): string {
+  return path.join(root, ".quality", "verbose.log");
+}
+
+function appendVerboseLog(root: string, line: string): void {
+  if (!isVerboseEnabled()) return;
+  const full = `${new Date().toISOString()} [DEBUG] ${line}`;
+  try {
+    fs.mkdirSync(path.join(root, ".quality"), { recursive: true });
+    fs.appendFileSync(verboseLogRoot(root), `${full}\n`);
+  } catch {}
+  try {
+    console.debug(`[${ENGINE_NAME}] ${full}`);
+  } catch {}
+}
+
+function verboseEnabled(): boolean {
+  return isVerboseEnabled();
+}
+
+export { appendVerboseLog, verboseEnabled, verboseLogRoot };
+

+import { resolveConfig } from "../../core/config-resolver.js";
+import type { VendorAdapter, VendorPayload, AdapterEvent } from "./types.js";
+
+function normalizedMode(value: unknown): string | null {
+  return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim().toLowerCase() : null;
+}
+
+function getPayloadValue(payload: VendorPayload, ...keys: string[]): unknown {
+  for (const key of keys) {
+    if (key in payload) return payload[key];
+  }
+  return undefined;
+}
+
+export const claudeAdapter: VendorAdapter = {
+  host: "claude",
+
+  isPlanMode(payload: VendorPayload): boolean {
+    if (normalizedMode(getPayloadValue(payload, "permissionMode", "permission_mode")) === "plan") return true;
+    return false;
+  },
+
+  resolveRoot(payload: VendorPayload): string {
+    const cwd = getPayloadValue(payload, "cwd") as string | undefined;
+    if (cwd) return resolveConfig({ cwd }).configRoot;
+    throw new Error("Cannot resolve workspace root from Claude payload");
+  },
+
+  onToolCall(payload: VendorPayload): AdapterEvent | null {
+    return { type: "DIRTY", payload };
+  },
+
+  onTurnStart(payload: VendorPayload): AdapterEvent | null {
+    return { type: "DIRTY", payload };
+  },
+
+  onTurnEnd(payload: VendorPayload): AdapterEvent | null {
+    return { type: "CANDIDATE_COMPLETE", payload };
+  },
+
+  getBackgroundTasks(_payload: VendorPayload): string[] | null {
+    return null;
+  },
+};
+

+import { resolveConfig } from "../../core/config-resolver.js";
+import type { VendorAdapter, VendorPayload, AdapterEvent } from "./types.js";
+import fs from "node:fs";
+import path from "node:path";
+
+function normalizedMode(value: unknown): string | null {
+  return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim().toLowerCase() : null;
+}
+
+function getPayloadValue(payload: VendorPayload, ...keys: string[]): unknown {
+  for (const key of keys) {
+    if (key in payload) return payload[key];
+  }
+  return undefined;
+}
+
+export const clineAdapter: VendorAdapter = {
+  host: "cline",
+
+  isPlanMode(payload: VendorPayload): boolean {
+    if (normalizedMode(getPayloadValue(payload, "permissionMode", "permission_mode")) === "plan") return true;
+    return false;
+  },
+
+  resolveRoot(payload: VendorPayload): string {
+    let candidate: string | undefined;
+    const roots = getPayloadValue(payload, "workspaceRoots", "workspace_roots");
+    if (Array.isArray(roots)) {
+      const validRoots = roots.filter((root): root is string => typeof root === "string");
+      const cwd = getPayloadValue(payload, "cwd");
+      if (validRoots.length === 1) candidate = validRoots[0];
+      else if (typeof cwd === "string") {
+        const normalizedCwd = fs.realpathSync(path.resolve(cwd));
+        const matching = validRoots.filter((root) => {
+          try {
+            const normalizedRoot = fs.realpathSync(path.resolve(root));
+            return normalizedCwd === normalizedRoot || normalizedCwd.startsWith(`${normalizedRoot}${path.sep}`);
+          } catch {
+            return false;
+          }
+        });
+        if (matching.length === 1) candidate = matching[0];
+        else if (matching.length > 1) throw new Error("Cline payload maps cwd to multiple workspace roots");
+      }
+    }
+    if (!candidate) candidate = getPayloadValue(payload, "cwd") as string | undefined;
+    if (!candidate) throw new Error("Cannot resolve workspace root from Cline payload");
+    return resolveConfig({ cwd: candidate }).configRoot;
+  },
+
+  onToolCall(payload: VendorPayload): AdapterEvent | null {
+    const tool = getPayloadValue(payload, "tool") as string | undefined;
+    if (tool && ["write_to_file", "replace_in_file", "apply_diff"].includes(tool)) {
+      return { type: "DIRTY", payload };
+    }
+    return null;
+  },
+
+  onTurnStart(payload: VendorPayload): AdapterEvent | null {
+    return { type: "DIRTY", payload };
+  },
+
+  onTurnEnd(payload: VendorPayload): AdapterEvent | null {
+    return { type: "CANDIDATE_COMPLETE", payload };
+  },
+
+  getBackgroundTasks(_payload: VendorPayload): string[] | null {
+    return null;
+  },
+};
+

+import { resolveConfig } from "../../core/config-resolver.js";
+import type { VendorAdapter, VendorPayload, AdapterEvent } from "./types.js";
+import fs from "node:fs";
+
+function normalizedMode(value: unknown): string | null {
+  return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim().toLowerCase() : null;
+}
+
+function getPayloadValue(payload: VendorPayload, ...keys: string[]): unknown {
+  for (const key of keys) {
+    if (key in payload) return payload[key];
+  }
+  return undefined;
+}
+
+function codexTranscriptReportsPlan(payload: VendorPayload): boolean {
+  const transcriptPath = getPayloadValue(payload, "transcriptPath", "transcript_path") as string | undefined;
+  const turnId = getPayloadValue(payload, "turnId", "turn_id") as string | undefined;
+  if (!transcriptPath || !turnId || typeof transcriptPath !== "string" || typeof turnId !== "string") return false;
+
+  try {
+    if (!fs.existsSync(transcriptPath)) return false;
+    const content = fs.readFileSync(transcriptPath, "utf8");
+    let foundPlan = false;
+    for (const line of content.split("\n")) {
+      if (!line.trim()) continue;
+      try {
+        const record = JSON.parse(line);
+        if (record.type !== "event_msg" || !record.payload) continue;
+        const eventPayload = record.payload as Record<string, unknown>;
+        if (eventPayload.type !== "task_started" || eventPayload.turn_id !== turnId) continue;
+        const collabMode = eventPayload.collaboration_mode_kind;
+        if (normalizedMode(collabMode) === "plan") {
+          foundPlan = true;
+        } else {
+          foundPlan = false;
+        }
+      } catch {}
+    }
+    return foundPlan;
+  } catch {}
+  return false;
+}
+
+export const codexAdapter: VendorAdapter = {
+  host: "codex",
+
+  isPlanMode(payload: VendorPayload): boolean {
+    if (normalizedMode(getPayloadValue(payload, "permissionMode", "permission_mode")) === "plan") return true;
+    if (normalizedMode(getPayloadValue(payload, "collaborationModeKind", "collaboration_mode_kind")) === "plan")
+      return true;
+    return codexTranscriptReportsPlan(payload);
+  },
+
+  resolveRoot(payload: VendorPayload): string {
+    const cwd = getPayloadValue(payload, "cwd") as string | undefined;
+    if (cwd) return resolveConfig({ cwd }).configRoot;
+    throw new Error("Cannot resolve workspace root from Codex payload");
+  },
+
+  onToolCall(payload: VendorPayload): AdapterEvent | null {
+    return { type: "DIRTY", payload };
+  },
+
+  onTurnStart(payload: VendorPayload): AdapterEvent | null {
+    return { type: "DIRTY", payload };
+  },
+
+  onTurnEnd(payload: VendorPayload): AdapterEvent | null {
+    return { type: "CANDIDATE_COMPLETE", payload };
+  },
+
+  getBackgroundTasks(payload: VendorPayload): string[] | null {
+    const tasks = getPayloadValue(payload, "backgroundTasks") as
+      Array<{ id: string; command: string; status: string }> | undefined;
+    if (!tasks) return null;
+    return tasks.filter((t) => t.status === "running").map((t) => t.command);
+  },
+};

+import { clineAdapter } from "./cline.js";
+import { codexAdapter } from "./codex.js";
+import { claudeAdapter } from "./claude.js";
+import type { VendorAdapter, VendorPayload, AdapterEvent } from "./types.js";
+
+const adapters: Record<string, VendorAdapter> = {
+  cline: clineAdapter,
+  codex: codexAdapter,
+  claude: claudeAdapter,
+};
+
+export function getAdapter(host: string): VendorAdapter | null {
+  return adapters[host] ?? null;
+}
+
+export function listAdapters(): VendorAdapter[] {
+  return Object.values(adapters);
+}
+
+export function processEvent(host: string, payload: VendorPayload): AdapterEvent[] {
+  const adapter = getAdapter(host);
+  if (!adapter) return [];
+
+  const events: AdapterEvent[] = [];
+
+  if (adapter.isPlanMode(payload)) {
+    events.push({ type: "PLAN_MODE", payload });
+    return events;
+  }
+
+  const dirty = adapter.onToolCall(payload);
+  if (dirty) events.push(dirty);
+
+  return events;
+}
+
+export function processTurnEnd(host: string, payload: VendorPayload): AdapterEvent | null {
+  const adapter = getAdapter(host);
+  if (!adapter) return null;
+  if (adapter.isPlanMode(payload)) return { type: "PLAN_MODE", payload };
+  return adapter.onTurnEnd(payload);
+}
+
+export function processTurnStart(host: string, payload: VendorPayload): AdapterEvent | null {
+  const adapter = getAdapter(host);
+  if (!adapter) return null;
+  if (adapter.isPlanMode(payload)) return { type: "PLAN_MODE", payload };
+  return adapter.onTurnStart(payload);
+}
+
+export function getBackgroundTasks(host: string, payload: VendorPayload): string[] | null {
+  const adapter = getAdapter(host);
+  if (!adapter) return null;
+  return adapter.getBackgroundTasks(payload);
+}
+
+export function resolveRoot(host: string, payload: VendorPayload): string {
+  const adapter = getAdapter(host);
+  if (!adapter) throw new Error(`Unknown host: ${host}`);
+  return adapter.resolveRoot(payload);
+}
+
+export { resolveRoot as resolveHookRoot };
+

+import fs from "node:fs";
+import os from "node:os";
+import path from "node:path";
+import { PassThrough } from "node:stream";
+import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
+import { describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";

+import { coordinateQualityCompletion } from "../src/core/completion-coordinator.js";
+import { clearActiveGateRun, readGateResult, writeActiveGateRun, writeGateResult } from "../src/core/gate-store.js";
+import { computeWorkspaceVersion } from "../src/core/version.js";

+import { startMatrixCoreMcpServer } from "../src/mcp/server.js";
+import type { GateResult, QualityCompletionResult } from "../src/core/types.js";
+
+function repository(): string {
+  const root = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "matrix-completion-regression-"));
+  fs.writeFileSync(
+    path.join(root, "quality.yaml"),
+    "version: 2\nproject: completion-regression\nreview:\n  agentsmith: false\n",
+  );
+  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root, ".gitignore"), ".quality/\n");
+  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root, "README.md"), "fixture\n");
+  spawnSync("git", ["init", "-q"], { cwd: root });
+  spawnSync("git", ["config", "user.email", "test@example.invalid"], { cwd: root });
+  spawnSync("git", ["config", "user.name", "MatrixCore Test"], { cwd: root });
+  spawnSync("git", ["add", "."], { cwd: root });
+  spawnSync("git", ["commit", "-qm", "fixture"], { cwd: root });
+  return root;
+}
+
+function gate(root: string, status: GateResult["status"] = "PASS"): GateResult {
+  const resolved = resolveConfig({ cwd: root });
+  const policy = resolvePolicyForConfig(resolved);
+  const workspaces = resolveWorkspaceSet(root, resolved.config.application);
+  const runtime = engineRuntimeIdentity();
+  return {
+    schemaVersion: 2,
+    version: computeWorkspaceVersion(root),
+    mode: "full",
+    fast: false,
+    baseBranch: "main",
+    changedFilesHash: null,
+    changedFileCount: 0,
+    status,
+    checks: [],
+    failures: [],
+    metrics: {},
+    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
+    createdBy: {
+      tool: "test",
+      adapter: "test",
+      engineVersion: runtime.version,
+      enginePath: runtime.executablePath,
+      enginePackageRoot: runtime.packageRoot,
+    },
+    workspaces: workspaces.workspaces,
+    workspaceHash: workspaces.workspaceHash,
+    policy,
+    toolVersions: {},
+  };
+}
+
+function completion(result: GateResult): QualityCompletionResult {
+  return {
+    version: result.version,
+    gate: result,
+    review: null,
+    reviewEnabled: false,
+    advisory: true,
+    passed: true,
+    deterministicPassed: true,
+    completionAllowed: true,
+    reviewMarkdown: "",
+    reviewArtifact: null,
+    advisoryReview: {
+      status: "disabled",
+      verdict: null,
+      findings: [],
+      errors: [],
+      profileId: null,
+      profileHash: null,
+    },
+  };
+}
+
+describe("completion regressions", () => {
+  it.runIf(process.platform !== "win32")("runs Node shims when the host PATH omits the MatrixCore Node runtime", () => {
+    const directory = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "matrix-node-shim-"));
+    const shim = path.join(directory, "tool");
+    fs.writeFileSync(shim, "#!/usr/bin/env node\nconsole.log('9.9.9')\n", { mode: 0o755 });
+    const original = process.env.PATH;
+    try {
+      process.env.PATH = directory;
+      expect(childProcessEnv().PATH?.split(path.delimiter)[0]).toBe(path.dirname(process.execPath));
+      expect(probeToolVersion(shim)).toMatchObject({ found: true, version: "9.9.9", exitCode: 0 });
+    } finally {
+      process.env.PATH = original;
+      fs.rmSync(directory, { recursive: true, force: true });
+    }
+  });
+
+  it("reports the real spawn failure instead of calling every probe missing", () => {
+    const probe = probeToolVersion(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "matrix-does-not-exist"));
+    expect(probe).toMatchObject({ found: false, errorCode: "ENOENT" });
+    expect(describeToolProbe("fixture", probe)).toContain("ENOENT");
+  });
+
+  it("does not replace terminal PASS while another full gate is active", () => {
+    const root = repository();
+    try {
+      const passed = gate(root, "PASS");
+      writeGateResult(root, passed);
+      writeActiveGateRun(root, "run-1", { ...passed, status: "RUNNING" });
+      expect(readGateResult(root, "full")?.status).toBe("PASS");
+      clearActiveGateRun(root, "run-1");
+    } finally {
+      fs.rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
+    }
+  });
+
+  it("coalesces concurrent completion calls for one repository", async () => {
+    const root = repository();
+    try {
+      let executions = 0;
+      const expected = completion(gate(root));
+      const execute = async () => {
+        executions += 1;
+        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 30));
+        return expected;
+      };
+      const [first, second] = await Promise.all([
+        coordinateQualityCompletion(root, undefined, execute),
+        coordinateQualityCompletion(root, undefined, execute),
+      ]);
+      expect(executions).toBe(1);
+      expect(first).toEqual(expected);
+      expect(second).toEqual(expected);
+    } finally {
+      fs.rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
+    }
+  });
+
+  it("cleans per-process MCP runtime records during cooperative shutdown", async () => {
+    const root = repository();
+    const input = new PassThrough();
+    const output = new PassThrough();
+    try {
+      recordEngineRuntime(root, "mcp");
+      const runtimeFile = path.join(root, ".quality", "mcp-runtime", `${process.pid}.json`);
+      expect(fs.existsSync(runtimeFile)).toBe(true);
+      const running = await startMatrixCoreMcpServer({ stdin: input, stdout: output, installSignalHandlers: false });
+      input.end();
+      await vi.waitFor(() => expect(fs.existsSync(runtimeFile)).toBe(false));
+      await running.close();
+    } finally {
+      input.destroy();
+      output.destroy();
+      fs.rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
+    }
+  });
+});

+      const policyHash = resolvePolicyForConfig(resolveConfig({ cwd: root })).policyHash;
+      turnStore.setDirty(root, hash, "codex", "turn-1");
+      turnStore.validationComplete(
+        root,
+        {
+          schemaVersion: 1,
+          repositoryHash: hash,
+          policyHash,
+          result: "REJECT",
+          checks: [],
+          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
+          gateVersion: hash,
+          gateMode: "full",
+          gateFast: false,
+        },
+        "codex",
+        "turn-1",
+      );
+      expect(turnStore.getState(root)).toMatchObject({ dirty: true, status: "REJECT" });
+
+      turnStore.validationComplete(
+        root,
+        {
+          schemaVersion: 1,
+          repositoryHash: hash,
+          policyHash,
+          result: "PASS",
+          checks: [],
+          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
+          gateVersion: hash,
+          gateMode: "full",
+          gateFast: false,
+        },
+        "codex",
+        "turn-1",
+      );
+      expect(turnStore.getState(root)).toMatchObject({
+        dirty: false,
+        status: "VALIDATED_COMPLETE",
+        validatedHash: hash,
+      });
+      expect(
+        turnStore.listEvents(root).some((event) => event.type === "VALIDATED_COMPLETE" && event.host === "codex"),
+      ).toBe(true);
+    } finally {
+      fs.rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
+    }
+  });
+
+  it("allows unconfigured repositories without creating gate state", async () => {
+    const root = tempRepo(false);
+    try {
+      await expect(renderHookDecision("codex", { cwd: root, turn_id: "turn-1" })).resolves.toEqual({});
+      expect(fs.existsSync(path.join(root, ".quality", "turn-state.json"))).toBe(false);
+    } finally {
+      fs.rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
+    }
+  });
+
+  it("blocks three times before exhausting the retry budget", async () => {
+    const root = tempRepo();
+    try {
+      const payload = { cwd: root, turn_id: "turn-1" };
+      await expect(renderHookDecision("codex", payload)).resolves.toMatchObject({ decision: "block" });
+      await expect(renderHookDecision("codex", payload)).resolves.toMatchObject({ decision: "block" });
+      await expect(renderHookDecision("codex", payload)).resolves.toMatchObject({ decision: "block" });
+      await expect(renderHookDecision("codex", payload)).resolves.toMatchObject({ decision: "error" });
+    } finally {
+      fs.rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
+    }
+  });
+
+  it("allows deterministic PASS while retaining a current advisory provider failure", async () => {
+    const root = tempRepo();
+    try {
+      fs.writeFileSync(
+        path.join(root, "quality.yaml"),
+        "version: 2\nproject: turn-test\nreview:\n  agentsmith: true\n",
+      );
+      const hash = computeWorkspaceVersion(root);
+      const resolved = resolveConfig({ cwd: root });
+      const policy = resolvePolicyForConfig(resolved);
+      const workspaceSet = resolveWorkspaceSet(root, resolved.config.application);
+      const runtime = engineRuntimeIdentity();
+      const gate: GateResult = {
+        schemaVersion: 2,
+        version: hash,
+        mode: "full",
+        fast: false,

+        changedFilesHash: null,

+          adapter: "cli",
+          engineVersion: ENGINE_VERSION,
+          enginePath: runtime.executablePath,
+          enginePackageRoot: runtime.packageRoot,
+        },
+        workspaces: workspaceSet.workspaces,
+        workspaceHash: workspaceSet.workspaceHash,
+        policy,
+        toolVersions: currentToolVersions(workspaceSet.workspaces, policy),
+      };
+      writeGateResult(root, gate);
+      fs.writeFileSync(
+        path.join(root, ".quality", "review-result.yaml"),
+        JSON.stringify({
+          schemaVersion: 2,
+          version: hash,
+          status: "partial",
+          outcome: "incomplete",
+          mode: "partitioned",
+          reviewer: "AgentSmith",

fileContents.ARCHITECTURE.md:
# MatrixCore architecture

MatrixCore is one review engine with adaptive candidate generation. Capture, repository
graph construction, projection planning, evidence resolution, verification, deduplication,
ranking, coverage, tracing, and output contracts are shared across model sizes.

```text
Capture + normalize
        |
Repository / change graph
        |
Projection planner (token budget + evidence)
        |
Mode router
   +----+------------------+
   |       |              |
holistic partitioned    hybrid
   |       |              |
strong  local +       strong scout
model   interaction    + targeted inspectors
   +-------+--------------+
           |
Candidate normalization
           |
Evidence resolution -> verification -> deduplication/ranking
           |
Unified ReviewResult + coverage + optional local trace
```

## Routing

The router treats context as a packing constraint. It reserves output and safety space and
uses at most 70% of the selected model context for input. A strong model receives a holistic
projection when the complete projection fits. Otherwise MatrixCore uses a compact strong-model
scout when configured, or bounded partitioned work.

Partitioned review always creates two kinds of work:

- local units inspect changed functions, classes, modules, or hunk fallbacks;
- interaction units compare high-value graph relationships such as callers/callees,
  interfaces/implementations, schemas/consumers, producers/consumers, configuration readers,
  and authorization boundaries.

This preserves local recall while proactively recovering one-hop cross-file defects. High-risk
changes may expand to a bounded second hop. Every unit uses the same candidate contract and feeds
the same evidence and verification pipeline.

The embedded policy bounds partitioned review to the four highest-priority candidate work items and
verifies at most four generated candidates (configurable higher, such as 8 + 8, for faster
providers). Parallelism defaults to one in-flight model call and the total review deadline defaults
to ten minutes; every limit is configurable. The complete worktree remains in the frozen manifest,
while lower-ranked and token-budget-omitted work is reported as bounded coverage rather than silently
treated as reviewed. AgentSmith does not control deterministic completion authorization. Timeouts
abort in-flight provider calls, preserve completed candidates, evidence, and verified findings, and
mark unfinished work as explicit timeout omissions; a timed-out review is always partial and must
never be interpreted as semantic approval.

## Approved local model profiles

The embedded policy currently provides:

| Profile | Model | Capability | Context |
| --- | --- | --- | ---: |
| `qwen35-9b-local` | `qwen3.5:9b-q4_K_M` | small | 8,192 |
| `qwen35-9b-verifier-local` | `qwen3.5:9b-q4_K_M` | small | 8,192 |
| `qwen35-122b-local` | `qwen3.5:122b-a10b` | strong | 131,072 |
| `qwen35-122b-scout-local` | `qwen3.5:122b-a10b` | strong | 131,072 |

Projects bind review roles to these policy-approved IDs:

```yaml
review:
  agentsmith: true
  mode: auto
  models:
    candidate: qwen35-9b-local
    scout: qwen35-122b-scout-local
    verifier: qwen35-9b-verifier-local
```

The binding above enables hybrid routing for changes that do not fit the small candidate model.
Use `qwen35-122b-local` as the candidate for holistic-first review when the full projection fits.
Model names are not inferred as strong, and projects cannot select arbitrary IDs from the embedded
policy. Install models explicitly with Ollama; MatrixCore never downloads them implicitly:

```bash
ollama pull qwen3.5:9b-q4_K_M
ollama pull qwen3.5:122b-a10b
```

## Evidence, verification, and coverage

Candidates must anchor to changed code. Unchanged files are resolved as supporting evidence only.
The verifier can reject unsupported, hypothetical, or out-of-scope claims. Only verified findings
are published. Results report changed-file/symbol coverage, local and interaction work, eligible
graph edges, evidence gaps, omissions, tokens, and global-scan scope.

## Traces and evaluation

Tracing is disabled by default and is local-only. `MATRIXCORE_TRACE=agentsmith` writes schema-v2
traces under `.quality/traces/agentsmith/`; there is no uploader or analytics endpoint. Curated
cases replay the same frozen snapshot through holistic, partitioned-local, partitioned-evidence,
partitioned-interactions, and hybrid variants and classify expected defects as L0 through L3.

See [README.md](README.md) for installation, [INSTALL_PROJECT.md](INSTALL_PROJECT.md) for project
setup, and [src/agentsmith/README.md](src/agentsmith/README.md) for implementation details.
fileContents.INSTALL_CLINE.md:
# Use MatrixCore with Cline

MatrixCore uses Cline's native MCP and hook systems. VS Code/JetBrains extensions use the native TaskComplete hook; Cline SDK, CLI, and Kanban can additionally install `integrations/cline/plugin.ts` for lifecycle-level enforcement.

## Install the package

Install the published package as a project dependency:

```bash
npm install --save-dev --save-exact @epv44/matrixcore@0.5.0
```

The supplied settings use `npx --no-install`, so they resolve only an already-installed local
binary and never download packages. Contributors working from a checkout may build and link that
checkout separately.

## Add MCP tools

Merge `integrations/cline/cline_mcp_settings.fragment.json` into Cline's `cline_mcp_settings.json`. Restart or reload MCP and confirm the `matrixcore` server exposes:

- `quality_run`
- `quality_status`
- `quality_fix`

## Enable completion enforcement

Copy `integrations/cline/hooks/TaskComplete` to the global or project Cline hooks directory on macOS/Linux and make it executable. On Windows copy `TaskComplete.ps1`. Enable hooks in Cline.

The hook reads Cline's JSON payload, checks the current deterministic artifact, and returns `cancel: true` when the gate is missing, failed, or stale. It does not run checks itself. Repositories without `quality.yaml` are unaffected.

## Workflow

1. Call `quality_run(mode=changed, fast=true)` after edits.
2. Call `quality_run(mode=review)` for combined deterministic and advisory review.
3. Call `quality_fix` with selected finding IDs and let the active Cline model edit code.
4. Call `quality_run(mode=full)` before completion.

Ollama is review-only. Its availability and findings never override deterministic completion policy.
